decision_cruda.rationale: LH-05 is down with a likely repair at 11:30, and radio and CMMS agree. The repaired loader can clear most of the stope itself by 17:00, so a loan adds little. LH-04 has the best net in rank_loan_options: +3.1 oz, with zero home loss and 0.42 h of travel. Every other loader nets less or is negative. I didn't send a second loader, since the extra ore would be small.
